text:
jun: Quick kickoff — small firebreak sprint to find ownerless KMS keys and accounts missing rotation policy. Keep changes staged and auditable.

alina: Plan: export entitlements and join KMS logs for 120d. I'll add `last_rotated` and `rotation_policy` in the report. SQL prototype: `SELECT e.principal,e.key_id,MAX(a.timestamp) AS last_seen,ANY_VALUE(e.rotation_policy) AS rotation_policy FROM entitlements e LEFT JOIN kms_logs a ON e.key_id=a.key_id GROUP BY e.principal,e.key_id`

paul: Canary approach: 2 non-prod keys, remove admin grant in staging, run scheduler replay + smoke tests for 24h. Monitor `kms.access_denied` and `service.errors`. If >3 denies in 10m, run `scripts/rollback_kms.sh`.

sec-oncall-bot: snapshot saved: `gs://sec-backups/ent-snap-1759999999.json` (3.4MB). Use `./ent apply --from=...` to restore.

audit-bot: candidates generated: 12 ownerless keys, 7 with missing rotation policy, 4 blocked by recent vuln tags. Link posted to internal report.

jun: Outreach template ready. Meeting Fri 09:30 PT to review candidate list and accept canary. Tag `#access-review` for any staging anomalies and page sec-oncall.
